records.source: Hello! You must be @, the new farmer. I'm Caroline.#$e#My husband runs the general store here. And have you met my daughter, Abigail? She's the pale one with the purple hair.
records.translation: Kumusta! Ikaw siguro si @, ang bagong magsasaka. Ako si Caroline.#$e#Pinatatakbo ng asawa ko ang tindahang pangkalahatan dito. At nakilala mo na ba ang anak kong si Abigail? Siya iyong maputla na may lilang buhok.

records.source: Thanks, sweetie. That's very kind of you to remember my birthday.$h
records.translation: Salamat, mahal. Napakabait mong naalala ang kaarawan ko.$h

records.source: Oh... is that... a birthday gift? I see... well, thanks for stopping by.$a
records.translation: Ah... Iyan ba ay... regalo sa kaarawan? Nauunawaan ko... Aba, salamat sa pagdaan.$a

records.source: Ooohh... this is nice. I'll save it for a quiet day in the sunroom.
records.translation: Ooohh... maganda ito. Itatabi ko para sa isang tahimik na araw sa silid-araw.

records.source: Oh, you've been foraging! Thank you!#$b#I'll make a spicy cocktail sauce with this. That'll put some hair on Pierre's chest.$h
records.translation: Ah, nangalap ka! Salamat!#$b#Gagawa ako ng maanghang na sarsang cocktail gamit ito. Tutubuan ng balahibo ang dibdib ni Pierre dahil dito.$h

records.source: I noticed you're growing tea on your farm. Make sure to bring me a cup!$h
records.translation: Napansin kong nagtatanim ka ng tsaa sa bukid mo. Tiyaking dalhan mo ako ng isang tasa!$h

records.source: Abby told me that you and her are seeing each other. That's sweet!
records.translation: Sinabi sa akin ni Abby na nagkikita kayong dalawa. Nakakatuwa naman!

records.source: I've never seen green rain before... It must not be too dangerous if you made it here!
records.translation: Hindi pa ako nakakita ng berdeng ulan... Siguradong hindi ito gaanong mapanganib kung nakarating ka rito!

records.source: Ah, the special rain is back! This year, I'm going to make the most of it!#$e#This calls for a cup of green tea!$h
records.translation: Ah, bumalik ang natatanging ulan! Ngayong taon, susulitin ko ito!#$e#Nararapat dito ang isang tasang berdeng tsaa!$h

records.source: It's fun to have a movie theater in town. I want to go see a western!
records.translation: Masayang may sinehan sa bayan. Gusto kong manood ng pelikulang Kanluranin!

records.source: I'm so happy for you two! Welcome to the family!$h
records.translation: Napakasaya ko para sa inyong dalawa! Maligayang pagdating sa pamilya!$h

records.source: Pierre's trying to play it cool, but he's seething about losing to you at the Stardew Valley Fair.
records.translation: Sinusubukan ni Pierre na magkunwaring ayos lang, pero kumukulo ang galit niya dahil natalo siya sa iyo sa Perya ng Stardew Valley.

records.source: Ah, the newlywed. So, how was the honeymoon?#$e#I see. Well, I guess the farm would wither if you took time away...
records.translation: Ah, ang bagong kasal. Kumusta ang pulot-gata?#$e#Nauunawaan ko. Aba, malalanta yata ang bukid kung magbabakasyon kayo...

records.source: Are you feeling relaxed? I bet...
records.translation: Panatag ba ang pakiramdam mo? Tiyak...

records.source: $y 'I heard you got a new kitchen! Think you'll be doing a lot of cooking?_I plan to!_It's a good skill to have. And with all those fresh ingredients on your farm, you'll be sitting pretty!_Nah, it's just for looks_I see. Well, don't forget to eat right... nutrition is important.'
records.translation: $y 'Narinig kong may bago kang kusina! Balak mo bang magluto nang madalas?_Balak ko!_Mabuting kasanayan iyon. At sa lahat ng sariwang sangkap sa bukid mo, napakaganda ng kalagayan mo!_Hindi, pampaganda lang iyon_Nauunawaan ko. Aba, huwag kalimutang kumain nang tama... mahalaga ang wastong nutrisyon.'

records.source: Judging by the savory smells wafting from your place, I can tell you've been busy in the kitchen!$h
records.translation: Batay sa masasarap na amoy mula sa tahanan mo, halatang naging abala ka sa kusina!$h

records.source: Willy gave us each a piece of his fish jerky. I'm still chewing on it.
records.translation: Binigyan kami ni Willy ng tig-isang piraso ng pinatuyong isda niya. Ngumunguya pa rin ako.

records.source: I'll sleep well tonight!$h
records.translation: Mahimbing ang tulog ko mamayang gabi!$h

records.source: The water is so warm here compared to the valley. It's really pleasant!
records.translation: Napakainit ng tubig dito kumpara sa lambak. Talagang kaaya-aya!

records.source: %Caroline is trying to nap.
records.translation: %Sinusubukang umidlip ni Caroline.

records.source: I told Gus to surprise me, and he made an iced green tea with mango zest. How nice!$h
records.translation: Sinabi ko kay Gus na sorpresahin ako, at gumawa siya ng malamig na berdeng tsaa na may kinudkod na balat ng mangga. Ang sarap!$h

records.source: Hi @. Are you here to relax, or to do work?
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Narito ka ba upang magpahinga o magtrabaho?

records.source: I wish Abby wouldn't spend so much time in her room.
records.translation: Sana hindi masyadong maraming oras ang ginugugol ni Abby sa silid niya.

records.source: Hi, @. Are you enjoying the married life? I hope so!
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Nasisiyahan ka ba sa buhay-may-asawa? Sana nga!

records.source: #$1 Caroline23#When we first moved to Pelican Town I would take secret walks to the Wizard's tower. Don't tell Pierre, he has jealousy issues.#$e#Abigail was born about a year after we moved to Pelican Town. I wonder if she'll ever experience life outside the valley?
records.translation: #$1 Caroline23#Noong una kaming lumipat sa Bayan ng Pelican, palihim akong naglalakad patungo sa Tore ng Mago. Huwag mong sabihin kay Pierre; madali siyang magselos.#$e#Ipinanganak si Abigail humigit-kumulang isang taon matapos kaming lumipat sa Bayan ng Pelican. Mararanasan kaya niya ang buhay sa labas ng lambak?

records.source: I've seen wild horseradish in the forest.#$e#Foraging can be a fun way to earn some cash. Or you can use what you find as gifts or food.
records.translation: May nakita akong Ligaw na Horseradish sa gubat.#$e#Maaaring masayang paraan ang Pangangalap upang kumita ng pera. O maaari mong gamiting regalo o pagkain ang mahahanap mo.

records.source: Hi there. Do you have everything you need for the farm?#$e#If not, we might be able to help you out.#$e#We carry a variety of useful items.
records.translation: Kumusta. Nasa iyo na ba ang lahat ng kailangan mo para sa bukid?#$e#Kung wala pa, baka matulungan ka namin.#$e#May sari-sari kaming kapaki-pakinabang na bagay.

records.source: #$1 Caroline1#Hmmm... I wonder if I can get Pierre to cook dinner tonight.#$e#Hmmm... what am I going to make for dinner tonight?#$e#Maybe I'll just get take-out from the Saloon.
records.translation: #$1 Caroline1#Hmmm... Mapapagluto ko kaya si Pierre ng hapunan ngayong gabi?#$e#Hmmm... Ano ang ihahanda kong hapunan ngayong gabi?#$e#Baka umorder na lang ako mula sa Saloon.

records.source: It's a fine-looking day.#$e#On days like this I like to help Evelyn with the public gardens.#$e#She's strong for her age, but I think she appreciates all the help she can get.
records.translation: Mukhang magandang araw.#$e#Sa mga ganitong araw, gusto kong tulungan si Evelyn sa mga pampublikong hardin.#$e#Malakas siya para sa edad niya, pero sa tingin ko ay pinahahalagahan niya ang lahat ng tulong na makukuha.

records.source: Is it just me, or does Abigail have an unhealthy interest in doom and gloom?#$e#Maybe I'm just too old to understand.
records.translation: Ako lang ba, o hindi malusog ang pagkahilig ni Abigail sa kapahamakan at kalungkutan?#$e#Baka masyado lang akong matanda upang makaunawa.

records.source: Dinner's been a lot quieter since Abigail moved out...#$e#No, not because she used to chew with her mouth open!$h
records.translation: Mas tahimik ang hapunan mula nang lumipat si Abigail...#$e#Hindi, hindi dahil ngumunguya siya nang nakabuka ang bibig noon!$h

records.source: Abby's always had a strange interest in the occult. I'm not sure where she gets it from...
records.translation: Noon pa man ay may kakaibang pagkahilig si Abby sa okultismo. Hindi ko alam kung kanino niya nakuha iyon...

records.source: Abby's always had a strange interest in the occult. I'm sure it's just a phase...
records.translation: Noon pa man ay may kakaibang pagkahilig si Abby sa okultismo. Tiyak na yugto lang iyon...

records.source: #$1 Caroline12#When we first moved here, I took a while to settle down... I wasn't ready for the domestic life.#$e#Pierre's a bit conventional... but he's a good man. He's ambitious, but he always puts his family first.
records.translation: #$1 Caroline12#Noong una kaming lumipat dito, natagalan bago ako nanatag... Hindi pa ako handa sa buhay sa tahanan.#$e#Medyo kumbensiyonal si Pierre... pero mabuti siyang tao. Ambisyoso siya, pero palagi niyang inuuna ang pamilya.

records.source: Today I'm just going to relax and think positively.#$e#Do you ever take a day off?
records.translation: Ngayon ay magpapahinga lang ako at mag-iisip nang positibo.#$e#Nagpapahinga ka ba kahit isang araw?

records.source: Stardew Valley is nice, but I wish I knew more people.#$e#I'm glad that we've become friends.
records.translation: Maganda ang Stardew Valley, pero sana mas marami akong kakilala.#$e#Natutuwa akong naging magkaibigan tayo.

records.source: On Wednesdays the shop is closed.#$e#Keep that in mind if you're going to need anything.
records.translation: Sarado ang tindahan tuwing Miyerkules.#$e#Tandaan mo iyon kung may kakailanganin ka.

records.source: I've been seeing wild fruits in the forest lately.#$e#Foraging can be a fun way to earn some cash. Or you can use what you find as gifts or food.
records.translation: May nakikita akong mga ligaw na prutas sa gubat nitong mga nakaraan.#$e#Maaaring masayang paraan ang Pangangalap upang kumita ng pera. O maaari mong gamiting regalo o pagkain ang mahahanap mo.

records.source: Hi there. Do you have everything you need for the farm?#$e#If not, we might be able to help you out.#$e#We carry a variety of useful items.
records.translation: Kumusta. Nasa iyo na ba ang lahat ng kailangan mo para sa bukid?#$e#Kung wala pa, baka matulungan ka namin.#$e#May sari-sari kaming kapaki-pakinabang na bagay.

records.source: Is it just me, or does Abigail look a little pale?#$e#Maybe I'm just worrying about her too much.
records.translation: Ako lang ba, o medyo maputla si Abigail?#$e#Baka masyado lang akong nag-aalala sa kaniya.

records.source: How's Abigail's health? She's always been such a pale girl. Hopefully the farm lifestyle puts a little color in her cheeks.
records.translation: Kumusta ang kalusugan ni Abigail? Noon pa man ay maputla na siya. Sana magbigay ng kaunting kulay sa mga pisngi niya ang pamumuhay sa bukid.

records.source: Today I'm just going to relax and think positively.#$e#Do you ever take a day off?
records.translation: Ngayon ay magpapahinga lang ako at mag-iisip nang positibo.#$e#Nagpapahinga ka ba kahit isang araw?

records.source: Time seems to go by faster and faster the older you get...$s
records.translation: Parang pabilis nang pabilis ang paglipas ng panahon habang tumatanda ka...$s

records.source: Fall is Abby's favorite season, so I'm hoping she'll come out of her room more often.
records.translation: Paboritong panahon ni Abby ang taglagas, kaya sana ay mas madalas siyang lumabas ng silid.

records.source: Abby was taking online classes here, but I don't think her heart was really in it...#$e#She's a free spirit, like I was before I met Pierre. She's probably having the time of her life on your farm.
records.translation: Kumukuha noon si Abby ng mga klase online dito, pero sa tingin ko ay wala talaga roon ang puso niya...#$e#Malaya ang espiritu niya, gaya ko bago ko nakilala si Pierre. Malamang ay napakasaya niya sa bukid mo.

records.source: I've seen edible mushrooms in the forest.#$e#Foraging can be a fun way to earn some cash. Or you can use what you find as gifts or food.
records.translation: May nakita akong mga nakakain na kabute sa gubat.#$e#Maaaring masayang paraan ang Pangangalap upang kumita ng pera. O maaari mong gamiting regalo o pagkain ang mahahanap mo.

records.source: Is it just me, or does Abigail play too many video games?#$e#Maybe I'm a little old-fashioned.
records.translation: Ako lang ba, o masyadong maraming video game ang nilalaro ni Abigail?#$e#Baka medyo makaluma ako.

records.source: You know, I used to want to be a farmer myself. Well, more like a rancher.#$e#I always loved movies about the wild west when I was a girl.
records.translation: Alam mo, gusto ko ring maging magsasaka noon. Aba, mas katulad ng tagapag-alaga ng hayop.#$e#Gustong-gusto ko noong bata ako ang mga pelikula tungkol sa ligaw na kanluran.

records.source: Winter is harsh, but you can dig up some roots if you're lucky.#$e#Foraging can be a fun way to earn some cash. Or you can use what you find as gifts or food.
records.translation: Malupit ang taglamig, pero maaari kang maghukay ng ilang ugat kung suswertehin.#$e#Maaaring masayang paraan ang Pangangalap upang kumita ng pera. O maaari mong gamiting regalo o pagkain ang mahahanap mo.

records.source: Even though it's cold, I still check on the public garden beds every now and then.#$e#I just want to make sure they aren't damaged too much before spring returns.
records.translation: Kahit malamig, tinitingnan ko pa rin paminsan-minsan ang mga taniman sa pampublikong hardin.#$e#Gusto ko lang tiyaking hindi masyadong masisira ang mga iyon bago bumalik ang tagsibol.

records.source: Don't you think Abby would look better with her natural hair color?#$e#She used to have light chestnut-colored hair.
records.translation: Hindi mo ba naiisip na mas babagay kay Abby ang likas niyang kulay ng buhok?#$e#Kulay mapusyaw na kastanyas ang buhok niya noon.

records.source: Are you excited for the new year?#$e#I predict that you'll be super-successful on your farm.$h
records.translation: Sabik ka ba sa bagong taon?#$e#Hinuhulaan kong magiging napakatagumpay mo sa bukid.$h
